data.name: Bithika
data.gender_notes: Bithika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bithika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Vidhya', which means knowledge or learning. This name is often given to girls to signify their pursuit of wisdom and intellectual growth. In Hindu mythology, Bithika is believed to be the goddess of learning and knowledge. The name Bithika carries the meaning “Goddess of Learning” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bithika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of learning and live with faith, good character and purpose.
